scenarios.title: webhook hardening: wrong token rejected, duplicate delivery ignored, a failure of the forwarder namespace never loops

assertions.name: wrong token is rejected (401)
missing token is rejected (401)
same delivery id as the real forward is ignored as duplicate (no second Hermes run)
a FAILED execution in hko.system does not fire the real forwarder (pattern excludes it)
misconfigured copy (pattern matches its own namespace): fires once, ends SUCCESS, no loop
guard skipped the HTTP call (no notify_hermes task run)
